3. Reductol V is much more
efficient in general than tobacco
industry methods in reducing tar,
nicotine and benzo(a)pyrene.
First, unlike filtration, Reductol V
does not make cigarettes more
difficult to light and puff on.
Second, filtration is responsible
also for loss of flavor, and often
this must be restored by the
manufacturer. Additives used for
the purpose may become toxic
when burned. To date, flavor or
reduction of it has not emerged as
a problem, or deterrent to use of
Reductol V. This is due in part to
Reductol V's ability to reduce
